name: merge-duplicate-notes
description: Find and merge duplicate or near-duplicate notes (rules, concepts, people, leads) with a deterministic similarity scan and a supersede-never-delete merge policy. Use to clean a notes vault of repeats without losing nuance. Triggers: "/merge-duplicate-notes", "clean up duplicates", "merge duplicates", "find repeats", "dedupe <folder>".
